FIELDS.NAME: Appliance Solutions & Repair
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Appliance Solutions & Repair, we specialize in the sale and repair of a wide range of household appliances, including refrigerators, washers, dryers, and kitchen appliances. Our operations are primarily conducted from our physical storefront located in Springfield, IL, where we maintain a secure inventory storage area that is locked and monitored. We offer both retail sales and quality repair services, ensuring all appliances are serviced by trained technicians who adhere to manufacturer installation protocols and safety standards. 

We conduct on-site repairs and installations, but to minimize risk, no more than 25% of our operations occur off-site. Safety is a top priority; therefore, our electrical system has been professionally upgraded within the last five years to meet current codes, and we have a centrally monitored alarm system in place to protect our inventory. 

Customer satisfaction is critical to us, and we ensure that all records of sales and repairs are meticulously maintained. Our partnerships are established with reputable manufacturers and distributors, allowing us to provide high-quality products and service.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 07/15/2022; Cause: Minor water damage due to a plumbing issue in a customer's home during installation service; Amount: $1,200; Status: Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 6 PM, Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with 24/7 monitoring and on-site watchpersons during business hours.
